task_2.title: Tolerate minor METADATA version updates
task_2.description: Package inspection now allows distributions whose package METADATA version is a newer minor version within a supported major metadata family, instead of failing only because the exact version is not known. Unsupported major metadata versions and missing metadata versions remain invalid. The update also relies on a pkginfo version with METADATA 2.4 support so newer package metadata can be parsed more reliably.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that package inspection does not fail solely because a distribution uses an unknown minor package METADATA version, while still rejecting absent metadata versions and genuinely unsupported major metadata versions.

expectation.grounded: When PackageInfo parses a pkginfo distribution, the metadata_version validation should accept a present version whose major component matches a metadata major version supported by pkginfo, even if the full minor version is not explicitly known. PackageInfo should continue parsing package fields and requirements for those accepted versions. It should continue to raise ValueError for missing metadata_version values or for metadata_version values whose major component is unsupported. The dependency baseline should include pkginfo support for METADATA 2.4.
expectation.conceptual: Users should be able to inspect or install packages that adopt a newer compatible metadata minor version without the operation failing only because the metadata specification advanced. Packages using invalid or incompatible metadata should still fail clearly.

constraints.grounded: Do not broaden acceptance to arbitrary new metadata major versions. Do not silently accept an empty or absent metadata_version. Do not change the existing PackageInfo parsing result for metadata versions already supported by pkginfo, and do not convert pkginfo's own fallback parsing behavior for accepted minor versions into a hard failure.
constraints.conceptual: Maintain strictness for incompatible metadata while adding forward compatibility for compatible minor metadata updates. Existing package metadata parsing should remain stable for already-supported distributions.

behavior: PackageInfo metadata version validation changes from exact full-version recognition to major-version compatibility.
A distribution with a present metadata_version whose major version is supported can be parsed even when its minor version is newer or not explicitly listed.
A distribution with no metadata_version still fails with ValueError.
A distribution whose metadata_version has an unsupported major version still fails with ValueError.
For accepted newer minor metadata versions, PackageInfo continues into normal metadata and requirement extraction using pkginfo's parsed distribution data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a distribution with a package METADATA version using a supported major version and a newer unknown minor version, when PackageInfo inspects it, it should return package information instead of failing solely due to the exact metadata version.
Given a distribution using METADATA 2.4 and a pkginfo release that supports it, when PackageInfo inspects it, it should parse through the normal package inspection flow.
Given an accepted newer minor METADATA version with requirements that pkginfo can parse, when PackageInfo inspects it, those requirements should remain available in the resulting package information.
Given a distribution with an absent metadata_version, when PackageInfo inspects it, it should raise ValueError.
Given a distribution with an unsupported metadata major version, when PackageInfo inspects it, it should raise ValueError.

task_1.title: Support newer package metadata versions
task_1.description: The update raises Poetry's pkginfo dependency floor and relaxes package metadata version handling so distributions using METADATA 2.4 or future minor metadata versions in a known major series can still be inspected instead of failing only because the exact metadata version is newer.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that package inspection accepts distributions with METADATA 2.4 and forward-compatible minor metadata versions within an already supported metadata major series, while still rejecting missing or entirely unsupported metadata major versions.

expectation.grounded: Require pkginfo >= 1.12 and update Poetry's PackageInfo inspection of pkginfo distribution metadata so METADATA 2.4 is supported. When pkginfo can parse metadata fields for a newer, unknown minor version whose major metadata series is already recognized, PackageInfo should continue parsing dependency and package information rather than raising solely because the exact metadata version is unknown. Any pkginfo warning about a newer metadata version may remain observable as a warning.
expectation.conceptual: Users should be able to add, resolve, or inspect packages built with newer compatible Python package metadata without Poetry treating the metadata version itself as a fatal error. Poetry should remain strict for metadata formats that are absent or outside the known compatibility family.

constraints.grounded: Do not silently accept distributions with no metadata version or with a metadata major version that pkginfo does not recognize. Preserve normal PackageInfo parsing results, source attribution, and dependency extraction for supported wheels and distributions.
constraints.conceptual: The change should improve forward compatibility for safe metadata minor-version changes without weakening validation for unknown metadata formats or changing behavior for already supported packages.

behavior: Poetry depends on pkginfo 1.12 or newer so metadata version 2.4 is understood by the metadata parser.
PackageInfo inspection accepts METADATA 2.4 instead of treating it as an unknown metadata version failure.
PackageInfo inspection accepts unknown newer minor metadata versions when their major metadata series is already recognized by pkginfo, relying on pkginfo's best-effort parsing behavior.
PackageInfo inspection continues to raise an error when the metadata version is missing.
PackageInfo inspection continues to raise an error when the metadata version belongs to an unrecognized major metadata series.
acceptance_criteria: When a package distribution declares METADATA 2.4, Poetry should inspect it successfully and retain its package and dependency information.

When a package distribution declares a newer unknown minor metadata version within a recognized major metadata series, Poetry should inspect it successfully if pkginfo can parse the relevant fields, while allowing pkginfo's warning to remain observable.
When a package distribution has no metadata version, Poetry should fail metadata inspection with an error rather than accepting it.
When a package distribution declares a metadata major version that pkginfo does not recognize, Poetry should fail metadata inspection with an error.
When a package distribution uses an already supported metadata version, Poetry should preserve the existing inspection behavior and extracted package information.
